title: Risk – Resources – Goal
summary: A model for examining business decisions in the context of objectives, available resources and possible risks.

text: The model helps to avoid looking at decisions in isolation. A measure can achieve a goal while at the same time creating new risks or a high demand for resources.
What goal should be achieved, what resources are available and what risks arise?
An organisation wants to make a process faster.
beispiel.note: Each option has a different resource requirement, different risks and a different expected impact.

text: The model provides a structured economic basis for decisions. It does not guarantee that a particular impact will actually occur.
